summary.prose: This Story adds CommentEntry and ReviewContextRound -- a flat, provenance-tagged freeform-context record and the root-level round field every review attempt stamps. The build is two Tasks: land the three types, then write the full named test suite proving CommentEntry's exact field set (no verdict/severity/dimension channel) and the absence of any cross-artifact scoping field.

tasks.title: Add CommentParty, CommentEntry and ReviewContextRound types
tasks.summary: Add type CommentParty = 'submitter' | 'reviewer', interface CommentEntry { readonly round, party, timestamp, text }, and interface ReviewContextRound { readonly round, comments: readonly CommentEntry[] } to src/workflow/artifact-core/types.ts, exactly sc5's interfaceSketch with zero additional fields, per the approved alternative a1.
acceptanceChecks: CommentParty, CommentEntry and ReviewContextRound are exported from types.ts with exactly sc5's interfaceSketch field shapes
CommentEntry carries no verdict, severity or dimension field of any kind
CommentEntry and ReviewContextRound carry no artifactId or other cross-artifact scoping field of any kind
tsc --noEmit passes with the new types in place

tests.name: CommentParty, CommentEntry and ReviewContextRound are exported with the exact documented field shapes

tasks.title: Write unit tests for CommentParty, CommentEntry and ReviewContextRound
tasks.summary: Add a flat kebab-case *.test.ts file under src/workflow/artifact-core/__tests__/ covering: the root-level round field, CommentEntry's exact field set (no verdict/severity/dimension), the absence of any cross-artifact scoping field, and the documented empty/duplicate-timestamp/empty-text edge cases -- one test case per testStrategy.testLevels subject, matching ac1/ac2/ac3's acceptanceMapping verbatim.
acceptanceChecks: Every subject named in the LLD's testStrategy.testLevels has a corresponding test case
ac1, ac2 and ac3's provingTests from the LLD's acceptanceMapping all pass
npx tsx --test for the new test file passes with zero failures

tests.name: a ReviewContextRound built for attempt N carries round=N at the root level
a CommentEntry carries round, party, timestamp and text as first-class fields
CommentEntry's exported shape contains no verdict, severity or dimension field of any kind
a CommentEntry.party value outside 'submitter'|'reviewer' is rejected at compile time (type-level check, not a runtime test)
CommentEntry's and ReviewContextRound's exported shapes contain no artifactId or other cross-artifact scoping field of any kind
a ReviewContextRound with an empty comments array is structurally valid
multiple CommentEntry values in the same round from different parties with identical timestamps are both recorded
a CommentEntry.text that is an empty string is structurally valid
